In 1927, Ambedkar led a procession of thousands of people to Chavdar Tank in Mahad. In a simple but revolutionary gesture, he drank water from the tank, asserting that water is a natural resource belonging to all.
Following the event, local caste Hindus said the tank had been "polluted" by Satyagrahis. They performed a "purification" ritual by pouring pots of milk, cow urine, dung into the tank.

Q13: In Sept 2023, RS MP Manoj Jha recited poem "X __ Y" by Dalit writer Z in Parliament. Jha twice clarified that he recites poem to kill the "X"(presiding spirit of egotism that often comes with high power), which is within all of us, not to create any animosity. However, as expected, this caused a massive stir.
Poem itself draws ideological inspiration from Munshi Ji's famous story of the same name.
Z, a titan of Dalit literature, didn't just write stories, Z built Dalit Chetna(Consciousness). Z's autobiography Joothan is considered a seminal document of social history, challenging "polite" sensibilities of Hindi literary world. Many critics found descriptions "too graphic" or "lacking in aesthetic beauty." Z countered that "beauty" was a luxury of the privileged.
Z argued that when one has lived through everyday violence and humiliation of untouchability, sugarcoating reality isn’t honesty, it’s denial.
ID X __Y, Z
